body.condition: \(m\) belongs to the radius-\(L\) Hölder ball \(C^{s}([0,1]^{d+1})\).

novel.justification: This fixed-radius global \(C^s\) restriction is an instrumental strengthened regular subclass, not a condition attributed to Takatsu and Westling (2025). It is credible for bounded clinical response surfaces represented by fixed-knot tensor splines with coefficients in a compact set.
